first_order: cautioning UVM to negotiate a non-interfering template with friendly Vikings
author: Danny-downer
text: Hey! I would caution you against that before talking to the Vikings people on their discord. We have a friendly relationship and I know they are using bots to protect that whole large rectangle all the way down to include a bit of our V. (So your work will automatically get undone) Last night they were talking about moving it 5 pixels to the left-don't know if that's still the case- that might open up just enough room to put it above us? If you come to them with a template that doesn't interfere significantly with theirs they might be amenable. I think we can also definitely help out once that's all figured out! I go to uvm too. :)
note: The speaker says Vikings use bots; this codes the participant's warning, not independent bot observation.
